data.long_meaning: Ansant is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ansan', which means 'without fear'. This name is a tribute to the bravery and fearlessness of the one it is bestowed upon. The name Ansant carries the meaning “Brave and Fearless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansant usually hope their child will grow to embody brave and fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
